mapper.insert: insert into ai_media_process_task(video_id, status, current_step, input_mode, created_by) values(#{videoId}, #{status}, #{currentStep}, #{inputMode}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: select id, video_id, status, current_step, input_mode, created_by, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at from ai_media_process_task where id = #{id}
select id, video_id, status, current_step, input_mode, created_by, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at from ai_media_process_task where video_id = #{videoId} order by id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update ai_media_process_task set status = 'PROCESSING', current_step = #{currentStep}, started_at = coalesce(started_at, now()), finished_at = null where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
update ai_media_process_task set status = 'SUCCESS', current_step = null, finished_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PROCESSING'
update ai_media_process_task set status = 'FAILED', current_step = #{currentStep}, finished_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PROCESSING'
update ai_media_process_task set status = 'PENDING', finished_at = null where id = #{id} and status = 'FAILED'
